reviews.text: Paid for the premium and they still expect me to watch ads to unlock chapters, stick to WEBTOON it’s a far better deal

To put it simply, it’s a brilliant app and website—honestly, the best one out there so far, since others I’ve seen have issues with the episodes. Now, the part I didn't like—aside from paying for a subscription that feels pretty pointless—is that even with the $70/year plan, you don't actually unlock the episodes; instead, you just get tickets to rent an episode for 70 hours. Basically, it’s a comic rental app where you pay by the episode. If you run out of tickets—which you burn through in just two comics—you have to buy gems to keep reading. Oh, the irony: it’s just an app designed to make you pay for every single episode.

reviews.title: Tricks people into thinking they have comics that they don’t
reviews.text: I am a comic creator.  This app has a fake link with my comic name that leads to their website.  I do not host my comic on their platform.  They do this solely to trick people who are looking for my comic into going to their site instead.  It’s really gross.

So you need 100 thousand (100,000)coins to get 1 gem or 500,000 for 5 gem aka 1 chapter of a comic. I’ll just go to a different app like webtoonz watch one chapter and get to read in entire episode

reviews.title: expensive
reviews.text: I just wanna read manga and only 5 ad episodes are available each day. After that you have to pay…to read the later episode. I look at the gem value and estimated..5$ gem value wont even last an hour of reading. Meaning it cost 5$+ to read on this app hourly. I cant afford that.

reviews.title: Horrible for FTP.
reviews.text: Listen man, I’m not one to make reviews bc I’m sure most of the time they get taken down. But honestly? This app isn’t worth it. You get wrapped up into a story just to have to spend money to read the rest. And you could get crystals for free, but the way they do it is so stupid. What do you mean 40k coins gets me .50 crystals??? Getting even 5 takes days just to be used for one chapter and you have to do it all over again. Not to mention the 5 ads a day thing isn’t a regular thing for a story you’ve read a lot of. For some stupid reason, when you get further into a story the option disappears for a while before randomly coming back. Honestly, not worth the time. Find the story on a random website for free, do not recommend.

reviews.title: Get rooked at web comics
reviews.text: You know what’s nice, buying a subscription to read a comic on web comics then realizing when your half way through the first comic you’ve read on this platform they want even more money on top of your subscription. The comic is good the greed to read is not worth it

reviews.title: Gem system?
reviews.text: The fact that I not only have to pay 5.99 a month to at least get some “free” mangas and I still have to get gems to be able to unlock the chapters of mangas is heinous work in my opinion. Don’t get me wrong though there are great mangas on this app and I’ve enjoyed the ones that I’ve read so far . I just wish that if I’m paying 5.99 a month that I wouldn’t need to also use gems to need to unlock the chapters one by one (it takes 4 gems to unlock on chapter and your only gifted 60 gems per week)
